name: big-bench-list-function-turing-330
description: A BIG‑Bench task that evaluates models on list/function reasoning problems inspired by Turing‑style list manipulation challenges. It tests algorithmic reasoning, pattern recognition, and the ability to produce correct structured outputs given natural language descriptions. Problems often require multi‑step reasoning about sequences and list operations.
reputation: Part of the BIG‑Bench suite, widely recognized in the LLM evaluation community as a challenging set of probe tasks.
